title: Educore AI Governance Policy: Authority, Scope & Dual-Track Architecture
content:
EDUCORE SERVICES ORGANIZATIONAL AI GOVERNANCE POLICY (EDU-AIMS-POL-v1.0):
Applicable network-wide across Central Administration, Educore Teacher Academies, and campuses (Sentinel Kabitaka, Trident College / Trident Solwezi, Frontier).
Dual-Track Governance Architecture:
• Track 1: Enterprise Business Operations - Governs Finance, Procurement, IT Infrastructure, HR, Legal, Facilities, and Operations. Enforces strict zero-leakage data security, financial calculation accuracy, vendor vetting, PII protection, and statutory compliance under the Zambian Data Protection Act (No. 3 of 2021).
• Track 2: Academic & Pedagogical Learning - Governs Teaching Faculty, Curriculum Leads, Academy Instructors, and Students. Enforces process-based learning, human-in-the-loop verification, Adelaide-style intellectual ownership declarations, and oral defense evaluations (Viva Voce).

title: Educore AI Tooling Registry: Classification Tiers (Tier 1 Authorized, Tier 2 SSO, Tier 3 Prohibited)
content:
EDUCORE AI SOFTWARE CLASSIFICATION REGISTRY:
• Tier 1: Authorized Enterprise AI (M365 Copilot Enterprise, Azure OpenAI Services, Azure AI Search / SharePoint RAG, M365 Copilot Finance). Fully authorized for work purposes under Enterprise Data Protection agreements with ZERO model retraining on Educore data. Authenticated via Entra ID SSO with Purview container controls.
• Tier 2: Conditionally Permitted SSO (Grammarly Business Enterprise, Canva AI Enterprise, Zoom AI Companion Enterprise). Permitted EXCLUSIVELY using official Educore M365 SSO logins. Strictly prohibited using personal accounts or for processing unencrypted student PII, health notes, or financial ledgers.
• Tier 3: Strictly Prohibited Consumer LLMs (ChatGPT Free/Plus personal accounts, Gemini Free personal accounts, Claude Personal, DeepL Free, Midjourney personal). STRICTLY BANNED for inputting any Educore work data, financial spreadsheets, payroll records, student PII, HR files, or proprietary code. Violations constitute a major enterprise security breach.

title: Educore Guardrail [Fin-01, Fin-02, Fin-03]: Finance, Accounting & Bursar Guardrails
content:
FINANCE & BURSAR OPERATIONAL GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Routine spreadsheet formatting, financial variance analysis, memo summarization using M365 Copilot Finance.
• Failure Edge: Model hallucinating formula syntax, rounding errors, skewing student fee arrear ledgers, cash flow forecasts, or subsidy allocations.
• Guardrail Fin-01 (Dual-Key Manual Audit): Independent human manual verification required for all AI-assisted financial calculations and balance sheet entries before ledger posting.
• Guardrail Fin-02 (PII & Commercial Data Masking): Mandatory depersonalization of all student NRC numbers, names, and First Quantum Minerals (FQM) mining partner subsidy data prior to AI prompt submission.
• Guardrail Fin-03 (Hardship Allocation Committee): Financial hardship or bursary decisions cannot rely on AI scoring and require unanimous human committee sign-off.

title: Educore Guardrail [Pro-01, Pro-02, Pro-03]: Procurement & Supply Chain AI Guardrails
content:
PROCUREMENT & SUPPLY CHAIN GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Summarizing vendor contracts, drafting RFP templates, market research across educational suppliers.
• Failure Edge: Trojan AI SaaS features ingesting enterprise data for retraining, leaking competitive tender pricing.
• Guardrail Pro-01 (Pre-Procurement Vendor AI Addendum): Mandatory vendor sign-off certifying zero data retention, zero model retraining, and IP indemnification before software purchase.
• Guardrail Pro-02 (Air-Gapped Tender Evaluations): Sealed tender bids, competitive pricing, and supplier proposals must be evaluated on offline, air-gapped spreadsheets.
• Guardrail Pro-03 (Legal Counsel Contract Sign-off): Legal Counsel must inspect all AI-assisted procurement contracts for IP liability before execution.

title: Educore Guardrail [IT-01, IT-02, IT-03]: IT Infrastructure & Software Development Guardrails
content:
IT INFRASTRUCTURE & DEVOPS GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Boilerplate code generation, shell script debugging, network documentation via GitHub Copilot Enterprise.
• Failure Edge: Accidental insertion of database connection strings, API keys, passwords, internal server IPs, or buggy scripts.
• Guardrail IT-01 (Pre-Commit Secret Scanning): Automated git pre-commit hooks and local secret-scanning pipelines to block prompts containing API keys or credentials.
• Guardrail IT-02 (Mandatory SAST & Senior Peer Review): All AI-generated scripts require automated security testing and Senior Engineer peer review sign-offs before production release.
• Guardrail IT-03 (48-Hour Staging Sandbox Isolation): AI-generated network or system scripts must undergo 48 hours of testing in isolated staging sandboxes before live execution.

title: Educore Guardrail [HR-01, HR-02, HR-03]: Human Resources & Personnel Guardrails
content:
HUMAN RESOURCES & PERSONNEL GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Drafting job descriptions, anonymizing employee survey responses, structuring staff professional development modules.
• Failure Edge: Algorithmic bias in candidate CV screening leading to unfair rejection, employee privacy violations, or statutory liability under Zambian Law.
• Guardrail HR-01 (Ban on Automated Candidate Rejection): Absolute prohibition on automated candidate rejection; human HR officers must conduct all shortlisting and performance appraisals.
• Guardrail HR-02 (Statutory Zambian DPIA Compliance): Mandatory Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for all HR data processing systems under Act No. 3 of 2021.
• Guardrail HR-03 (Appraisal Observation Evidence Logs): Annual employee appraisals must reflect direct human supervisor observation logs, not AI-summarized feedback.

title: Educore Guardrail [Leg-01, Leg-02]: Legal, Compliance & Executive Guardrails
content:
LEGAL, COMPLIANCE & EXECUTIVE GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Contract clause extraction, regulatory tracking, formatting executive board briefing materials.
• Failure Edge: AI hallucinating false Zambian statutory acts, legal precedents, or court rulings; delegating executive governance decisions to predictive models.
• Guardrail Leg-01 (Statutory Legal Verification): Legal Counsel must verify all AI-extracted legal references against official Republic of Zambia statutory books.
• Guardrail Leg-02 (Executive Non-Delegable Accountability): Board risk decisions and institutional policies cannot be delegated to AI models under ISO 42001 Clause 5.1.

title: Educore Guardrail [Edu-01, Edu-02, Edu-03]: Academic Faculty & Classroom Educator Guardrails
content:
ACADEMIC FACULTY & EDUCATOR GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Azure-hosted lesson planning, rubric criteria design, formatting differentiated reading materials.
• Failure Edge: AI generating incorrect academic facts in student handouts; automated grading tools mis-scoring summative exams.
• Guardrail Edu-01 (Prohibition of Automated Summative Grading): Summative exam scoring and final report card marks must be assigned by human educators.
• Guardrail Edu-02 (Human-in-the-Loop Syllabus Verification): Faculty must verify all AI-generated teaching resources against official Cambridge and Zambian syllabi.
• Guardrail Edu-03 (Student Depersonalization Rule): Educators must strip all student names, IDs, and pastoral notes before using AI for lesson differentiation.

title: Educore Guardrail [Stu-01, Stu-02, Stu-03]: Student & Learner Guardrails (Tier C)
content:
STUDENT & LEARNER GUARDRAILS (TIER C):
• Permitted: Interactive study guidance via Azure Socratic RAG tutors (Math/Physics) providing step-by-step diagnostic hints without direct answers.
• Failure Edge: Cognitive bypass (students generating complete essays or fake prompt logs using AI); using 4G mobile hotspots to bypass campus firewalls.
• Guardrail Stu-01 (Process-Based Viva Voce Oral Defenses): Educators conduct unassisted in-class oral defenses and timed synoptic writes to verify genuine student mastery.
• Guardrail Stu-02 (Declaration of Intellectual Ownership): Students attach signed Adelaide-model sole-authorship pledges to all major assignments, taking full responsibility for submitted ideas.
• Guardrail Stu-03 (Individual Viva Voce for Group Work): Group project submissions require individual oral spot-checks to ensure equal contribution and prevent AI free-riding.

title: Educore Guardrail [Fac-01, Fac-02]: Facilities, Physical Security & Safety Guardrails
content:
FACILITIES, PHYSICAL SECURITY & CAMPUS SAFETY GUARDRAILS:
• Permitted: Campus maintenance route optimization, energy tracking, containerized IT helpdesk ticket triage.
• Failure Edge: Deploying facial recognition or emotion tracking at campus gates; AI bots auto-closing critical physical safety hazard tickets.
• Guardrail Fac-01 (EU AI Act Article 5 Emotion/Facial Ban): Strict prohibition on facial recognition or emotion tracking at school gates or workplaces.
• Guardrail Fac-02 (Immediate Human Emergency Dispatch): Physical safety, electrical hazard, or security tickets automatically bypass AI triage and dispatch human responders instantly.

title: Educore AI Framework Implementation Handbook: ISO 42001 AIMS & 6-Step AIIA Protocol
content:

Master governing authority establishing a certifiable Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) aligned with ISO/IEC 42001:2023, EU AI Act, and Zambian Data Protection Act (No. 3 of 2021).
Incorporates all 38 ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Annex A reference controls and mandates the 6-Step AI System Impact Assessment (AIIA):
AIIA 6-Step Sequence:
1. Trigger Screening: Identify proposed AI use-case, classification tier, and user base.
2. Data Provenance & Purview Review: Verify data sources, licensing, and Purview sensitivity container mapping.
3. Rights & Harm Mapping: Assess risks of bias, cognitive bypass, student privacy violations, or financial error.

title: Educore Ai Framework Implementation Handbook V2 0: Educore Ai Framework Implementation Handbook V2 0 (Part 1)
content:
EDUCORE AI FRAMEWORK IMPLEMENTATION HANDBOOK V2 0:
Educore AI Framework Implementation Handbook
Master Operating Authority, AIMS Architecture, LTCES Decision Filters & Technical Topology | Version 2.0
1. Central Governance Charter & Modular Hub & Spokes Model
This Handbook serves as the master operating authority for the Educore AI Governance Framework. Operating under a modular Hub and Spokes architecture, central governance sets overarching strategy, data protection boundaries, security standards, and AIMS compliance, while individual spokes (Policy, Action Plan, Discovery Audit, Cognitive Bypass Checklist) govern domain-specific execution across Sentinel Kabitaka, Trident College, Frontier, and the Educore Teacher Academies.
2. Microsoft Cloud, Identity & Purview Security Topology
Educore's technical architecture leverages a Microsoft-first cloud stack: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Single Sign-On (SSO) for identity and role-based access control (RBAC); Microsoft Purview Information Protection for data loss prevention (DLP); Azure OpenAI Services for enterprise model endpoints; and Azure AI Search for secure, SharePoint-indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). All enterprise tenants operate under strict zero data retention contracts.
3. Progressive Agent Autonomy Spectrum & AI Agent Register
To manage AI agents effectively, Educore establishes an explicit 4-level Progressive Agent Autonomy Spectrum:
Level 1 (Read Only): Agent queries documents and synthesizes summaries; zero system modification rights.

title: Educore Ai Framework Implementation Handbook V2 0: Educore Ai Framework Implementation Handbook V2 0 (Part 2)
content:
EDUCORE AI FRAMEWORK IMPLEMENTATION HANDBOOK V2 0:
Level 1 (Read Only): Agent queries documents and synthesizes summaries; zero system modification rights.
Level 2 (Recommend): Agent generates recommendations or draft options for human approval; zero direct execution.
Level 3 (Assist): Agent executes pre-approved sub-tasks under direct human supervision.
Level 4 (Act - Autonomous): Agent executes system actions independently. Restricted to low-risk administrative workflows following Steering Committee sign-off.
All deployed AI agents must be logged in the Central AI Agent Register, detailing agent name, business owner, technical scope, autonomy level, and risk tier.
4. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS Control Framework & 6-Step AIIA SOP
Educore aligns its Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) with ISO/IEC 42001:2023 across 38 Annex A controls. Before any high-risk AI tool is deployed, it must complete the 6-Step AI Impact Assessment (AIIA) Workflow: (1) System Scoping & Intent; (2) Data & Privacy Impact Analysis; (3) Algorithmic Risk Identification; (4) Non-Software Guardrail Mapping; (5) Stakeholder Impact Review; and (6) Steering Committee Authorization.
5. Trident LTCES Evaluation & 7-Question Business Case Review
Every proposed AI tool must pass the Trident LTCES Framework (Learning Purpose, Teacher Empowerment, Community Alignment, Ethical Safety, Sustainability) and the 7-Question Business Case Test to verify ROI, technical feasibility, and alignment before entering pilot testing.

content:
EDUCORE SERVICES ORGANIZATIONAL AI GOVERNANCE POLICY:
DOC-01: Daily Operational Rules, Departmental Guardrails & Decision Filters (v3.0)
1. Authority, Scope & Decision Screening Frameworks
This policy establishes the official operational rules governing Artificial Intelligence deployment across Educore Services Limited. It operates under a Dual-Track Governance Architecture to balance corporate operational security with pedagogical excellence:
Track 1: Enterprise Business Operations — Governs Finance, Procurement, IT Infrastructure, HR, Legal, Facilities, and Corporate Operations. Focuses strictly on data security, financial calculation accuracy, vendor contract vetting, PII protection under the Zambian Data Protection Act (No. 3 of 2021), and statutory legal compliance.
Track 2: Academic & Pedagogical Learning — Governs Teaching Faculty, Curriculum Leads, Academy Instructors, and Students. Focuses on process-based learning, human-in-the-loop verification, Adelaide-style intellectual ownership declarations, and 4-Level Assessment Use Modes.
1.1 The Trident LTCES Pre-Pilot Decision Filter
Before any new AI software, tool, or workflow is submitted for pilot testing or departmental adoption, it must pass the 5-dimension LTCES evaluation framework:
• L – Learning Impact: Does the tool directly enhance educational quality, student engagement, or a defined learning outcome?
• T – Teacher & Staff Empowerment: Does it empower teaching and administrative staff, reduce friction, and save workload without creating technological dependency?

content:

• T – Teacher & Staff Empowerment: Does it empower teaching and administrative staff, reduce friction, and save workload without creating technological dependency?
• C – Community & Cultural Alignment: Does it align with community culture, preserve trust, and safeguard stakeholder wellbeing across all campus sites?
• E – Ethical & Privacy Safety: Is the tool safe, transparent, non-discriminatory, age-appropriate, and fully compliant with data privacy laws?
• S – Sustainable Infrastructure: Is the solution technically feasible, financially viable (TCO evaluated), supportable long-term, and cloud-secure?
1.2 The 7-Question Executive Business Case Test
Every departmental AI initiative requiring budget allocation or software integration must satisfy the Board Draft 7-Question Test: (1) What specific operational problem is being solved? (2) What is the expected measurable benefit? (3) Is implementation operationally feasible? (4) Can privacy risks be controlled? (5) What is the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)? (6) Would a non-AI solution be more effective? (7) How will success be evaluated?

The 4-Level Assessment Use Modes (Trident Framework)
To protect academic integrity while building student AI literacy (Ask -> Analyse -> Verify -> Improve -> Create), all coursework assignments across Sentinel Kabitaka, Trident College, and Frontier must display an explicit Assessment Mode Label:
• Level 1: Prohibited — AI usage is completely prohibited. 100% human unassisted effort required (in-class synoptic writes, timed exams).
• Level 2: Limited — AI permitted solely for initial brainstorming, topic exploration, or outline structuring. Raw text generation banned.
• Level 3: Supported — AI permitted for editing draft text, checking grammar, formatting code, and receiving feedback. Final text must be student-authored.
• Level 4: Integrated — AI collaboration is an explicit, assessed component of the learning task (e.g., prompt engineering, critically auditing AI output).

DOC-03: Technical Discovery, 10-Question Survey & ISO 42001 Asset Schema (v3.0)
1. 3-Vector Pre-Rollout Discovery Audit Methodology
To establish an accurate pre-policy risk baseline during Phase 1 (Days 1–30), IT Infrastructure and Compliance leads execute a 3-vector discovery methodology:
Vector 1: Technical Network & CASB Firewall Log Scans — IT security analyzes 90 days of DNS logs, CASB traffic, and proxy gateway data across all campus networks to identify active connections to public LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Midjourney) and unauthorized EdTech platforms.
Vector 2: Purview SharePoint PII Content Scans — Automated Purview crawlers scan SharePoint Online and OneDrive libraries for unencrypted sensitive data, matching Zambian National Registration Card (NRC) regex patterns (\b\d{6}/\d{2}/\d{1}\b), credit card strings, payroll ledgers, and student health files.
Vector 3: SaaS Expense & Financial Procurement Log Audits — Finance inspects corporate credit card logs, departmental expense claims, and IT procurement records for hidden SaaS subscriptions containing embedded AI capabilities.
2. Tailored 10-Question Departmental Survey Instrument
The following survey is deployed across all administrative department leads, campus principals, HODs, and technical staff during Phase 1:
Q1: Current Tool Usage: Which AI tools, browser extensions, or platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Grammarly, Canva, Copilot) do you or your team currently use for work or teaching tasks?

Vector 1: Artifact Sampling & Assessment Mode Inspection — Random monthly sampling of student submissions to verify compliance with assigned Assessment Use Mode Labels (Level 1 Prohibited, Level 2 Limited, Level 3 Supported, Level 4 Integrated).

Vector 3: Unassisted Viva Voce Oral Defenses & Synoptic Writes — Conducting brief, 3-minute unassisted oral defenses and in-class synoptic writing checks where students explain their research methodology, arguments, and source choices.
Vector 4: Gradebook Variance Benchmarking — Statistical analysis comparing student take-home assignment marks against supervised, in-class exam performance. Discrepancies exceeding 20% trigger a Viva Voce review.
